arithmetic_contract.block_schedule: aligned blocks of 2^20 entries, followed by the same zero-padded adjacent tree; adding padding zeros is exact
arithmetic_contract.candidate_inside_action: return stored widened FP32 candidate bit-for-bit
arithmetic_contract.candidate_outside_action: apply the locked downward-scalar radial clip; use fl32(S/2) only on exceptional arithmetic or an unusable clip
arithmetic_contract.clip_scalar_order: downward binary64 Nhat(S)/Nhat(Dhat), then downward binary64 multiply by 890/2048, then downward binary32 conversion
arithmetic_contract.input_order: validate dtype/shape, widen BF16 exactly to FP32, reject nonfinite signal, then evaluate candidate guard
arithmetic_contract.nonfinite_candidate: ignore candidate and attempt certified S/2 fallback
arithmetic_contract.norm_scalar: binary32 max scale and unit norm multiplied exactly in binary64
arithmetic_contract.subnormal_signal: below normal anchor, S/2 is returned only if every stored entry halves exactly; otherwise fail closed
arithmetic_contract.threshold: one binary64 product followed by nextafter toward -infinity
arithmetic_contract.underflow: gradual underflow required; FTZ/DAZ probe failure is fail-closed
